title: Finish the Artifact with Evidence and Revision

blocks.title: Finish the same bounded project
blocks.text: Use the approved charter and actual retained work. Preserve a baseline, lead a material revision, and retest it. A required criterion that still fails remains pending.

SUPPLIED FICTIONAL TRAINING CASE: A reviewed intake process must handle complete input, a missing delivery date, and absent human approval. The baseline produces a draft but treats completed input as permission to deliver. No live system, real customer, actual delivery, or measured benefit is demonstrated. The following tabletop observations are supplied for teaching; your project requires your own tests.
